link.title: Paper Seminar: Audio-Aware Robot Policies (MultiGen & HEAR)

entry.content:
Overview

Seminar on how robot policies can use sound, built around two papers.

Bottleneck Paper Links
Sound is hard to simulate (data) MultiGen: The Sound of Simulation, CoRL 2025 arXiv · Project · Code
Short sounds are missed while acting (architecture) HEAR: Towards the Vision-Sound-Language-Action Paradigm, IJRR 2026 arXiv · Project · Code · Dataset

Slides

Download the slides (PDF)

The videos shown in the talk are not hosted here. Please see the original project pages above.

References

  1. R. Wang et al. The Sound of Simulation: Learning Multimodal Sim-to-Real Robot Policies with Generative Audio. CoRL 2025. arXiv:2507.02864.
  2. C. Nie, T. Deng, G. Wang, Z. Liu, H. Wang. Towards the Vision-Sound-Language-Action Paradigm: The HEAR Framework for Sound-Centric Manipulation. IJRR 2026. arXiv:2603.16086.

Figures from MultiGen (Wang et al., CoRL 2025) are used under CC BY 4.0. Figures from HEAR (Nie et al., IJRR 2026) are reproduced for review purposes, and credit belongs to the original authors.
entry.summary: Seminar slides on two audio-aware robot policy papers: MultiGen (generative audio for sim-to-real) and HEAR (streaming auditory memory)
